$comment: Evidence gathered on 23 Oct 2026 by the build session through its connectors (Supabase, n8n, GitHub) and other real reads the preflight script cannot repeat from here. Merged by scripts/preflight.ts and dated by run_at: a fresh script result that is verified or refused wins; evidence older than the configured age becomes 'unfilled'. Annotations add a finding to an item whatever its source. Every 'ran' is a real call made that day.
